start.title: [TODO:ko] From a Distance
start.text:
[TODO:ko] Torches lead Jesus away in chains.
Your heart pounds. Do you dare follow?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Run home and hide your shame

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] This hour is not for swords.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Do Not Abandon
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] He needs witness, not abandonment.
Return to His shadow.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You turn back into the night.

charge_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not by Force
charge_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] He told you to put the sword away.
Follow softly, not in fury.

gate.title: [TODO:ko] The Outer Gate
gate.text:
[TODO:ko] John speaks to the gatekeeper for you.
The door creaks open into firelight.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Lie about your name at once

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Yet, Peter
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Boasting once cost you everything.
Enter humbly tonight.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You step softly past the gate.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Silence Over Lies
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] One lie always asks for another.
Go in without a word.

courtyard_fire.title: [TODO:ko] Among the Guards
courtyard_fire.text:
[TODO:ko] Cold bites your hands. A fire crackles.
Guards and servants warm themselves.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your face still catches the glow.

joke_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Like This
joke_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Your loud voice will undo you.
Quiet your heart instead.

pray_path.title: [TODO:ko] A Whispered Prayer
pray_path.text:
[TODO:ko] You ask for strength you do not feel.
A servant girl steps closer.

first_recognized.title: [TODO:ko] You Were With Him
first_recognized.text:
[TODO:ko] A servant girl says, "You were with
the Galilean. I know your face."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your stomach turns at your words.
[TODO:ko] Truth would have set you free.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Glare at her in furious silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Silence here is its own denial.

confess_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] If You Had Spoken
confess_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] The harder road would have held you.
But fear pulls another way.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The lie slips out before you stop it.

glare_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Words Spill Out
glare_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Your silence draws more eyes than words.
Fear loosens your tongue.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The first denial leaves your lips.

second_recognized.title: [TODO:ko] Another Voice
second_recognized.text:
[TODO:ko] Another servant points: "This one too
was with Jesus of Nazareth."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your voice trembles with the lie.
[TODO:ko] Truth would still spare your soul.

walk_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] More Eyes Turn
walk_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Returning only sharpens the questions.
The lie is already on your lips.

admit_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Fear Wins Again
admit_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Truth shines for a moment in your heart.
Then fear smothers it.

third_accusation.title: [TODO:ko] Your Accent Betrays You
third_accusation.text:
[TODO:ko] A man insists: "Surely you are one.
Your Galilean speech gives you away."

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your own oath cuts the night.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] "I am His. Strike me if you must."
[TODO:ko] Flee through the gate at once

courage_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Fear Speaks Louder
courage_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Courage flickers, then fades to ash.
The oath rises up instead.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] The Door Is Closed
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Guards block the gate behind you.
Only your tongue can buy escape now.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"

rooster.title: [TODO:ko] A Rooster Crows
rooster.text:
[TODO:ko] Far off, a rooster splits the dark.
Across the court, His eyes find yours.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Look away and pretend not to see
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] His gaze has already pierced you.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Shout that it is not your fault
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Only honest grief can heal this.

lookaway_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] He Sees You Anyway
lookaway_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] No shadow can hide you from love.
Let His look reach you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] His eyes are sorrow, not scorn.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Stop the Shouting
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Excuses cannot hold the truth back.
Only tears can.

weeping.title: [TODO:ko] Out Into the Night
weeping.text:
[TODO:ko] "Before the rooster crows, you will
deny me three times." You remember.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Harden your heart and walk on
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] A broken heart is the doorway.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Blame the guards for the lie
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Only your own heart can answer.

harden_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Let the Tears Come
harden_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] A hardened heart cannot be forgiven.
A broken one already is.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Own the Failing
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] The fault is yours. Mercy waits for it.
Carry it honestly into the night.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You step into the cold and weep.

ending.title: [TODO:ko] Bitter Tears
ending.text:
[TODO:ko] Beyond the gate you fall to your knees.
Mercy will find you here, even now.
